title: Meeting Lips Page in Kansas City
summary: Boots Castle introduces Leeman to Oran 'Lips' Page, whom he found gracious and the most beautiful of men.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Could you talk a little bit about Oran "Lips" Page.

They were going to open in a half hour over across the street, the Reno Club, but here I saw somebody coming down the street, and she said, "I want you to meet a boy that is a musician from back east" and this man turned out to be Lips Page.
Was this lady white or black?
I see. In Kansas City -- and she introduced you to Lips Page.

That's how it happened. The Reno was across the street, and I hadn't entered it yet because it hadn't opened yet, and this was the first time I saw him -- he had a horn under his arm and a velvet case that somebody had made him, this little case. And that's the first time I had ever seen anybody with a horn case like that.
Well, tell me -- what kind of dude was he?
He was just beautiful, he was most gracious and he was nice to me, I thought I was talking to Louis Armstrong, who I had heard on records, but I had never met anybody like that.
My wife says the same thing about him.
He was the most beautiful man, among other beautiful people, he is the epitome.
